{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CeedAKj7Np1n4eER9msDe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"The lookup for n=7 returned 49 (which is just 7²), but that number doesn't bear on the primality question directly — instead, based on mathematical definition, 7 **is** a Mersenne prime because it can be written as 2³ − 1 = 8 − 1 = 7, and both 7 and the exponent 3 are prime, satisfying the Mersenne prime condition (a prime of the form 2^p − 1)."}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":522,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":441,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":301},"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"}}
